originality.rationale: Compared mathematical implications. The source theorem assumes inverse compatibility and does not give counterexamples or sharp minimality. The older dioid-partition theory assumes inverse compatibility in its definition and cannot cover inverse-incompatible witnesses. Comparisons with published primary papers and indexed mathematical summaries found no same-group or broader covering result. Inversion compatibility is explicitly refuted with full class products and two inverse candidates. Literature priority remains provisional.

The primary older paper was read in its relevant definition/theorem/partition passages rather than every page; the checked statements do not imply the new claim.

value.rationale: Identifies the exact first obstruction to dropping an inversion hypothesis from the recently introduced polygroupoid quotient theorem, in both general and abelian groups. Not just an isolated counterexample: gives two sharp minimal orders, exact complete first-stratum counts and a canonical automorphism orbit, with a directly motivated failure of hypergroup inverses.
